AnalyticsResponse.description:
GET /api/funds/{code}/analytics — NAV-derived risk/behaviour analytics.

All figures are NAV-to-NAV; for IDCW/DIVIDEND see ``methodology``
(not total return, comparison-ineligible).
AnalyticsResponse.title: AnalyticsResponse

FundDetail.description: GET /api/funds/{code} — the full v2 detail response.
FundDetail.title: FundDetail

FundFact.description:
fund_facts subset served by the detail endpoint (v1 shape unchanged).

``status`` / ``transaction_status`` are LEGACY, non-authoritative facts:
they are not a buyability signal and nothing in the contract is derived
from them.
FundFact.title: FundFact

FundLifecycle.description:
Evidence-backed lifecycle. Absence or a stale NAV alone yields
``unknown`` — there is deliberately no "matured" boolean in the contract.
FundLifecycle.title: FundLifecycle

FundMethodology.description:
How the NAV-derived numeric fields must be read. For IDCW/DIVIDEND the
numbers are NOT total return and the series is comparison-ineligible.
FundMethodology.title: FundMethodology

FundNavFreshness.description:
Objective NAV freshness. The bands are server-owned (see
queries.FRESHNESS_*_DAYS); consumers must not redefine them.
FundNavFreshness.title: FundNavFreshness

FundNavQuality.description:
Durable NAV-quality assessment read-through. Signals are DETECTION
signals, not proof that a stored NAV is wrong; ``assessment_status``
describes the assessment's currency, never the fund's cleanliness.
FundNavQuality.title: FundNavQuality

FundSibling.description: One variant-group sibling offered for navigation.
FundSibling.title: FundSibling

MoversResponse.description:
GET /api/movers — comparison-eligible series only (IDCW/DIVIDEND
excluded: their NAV changes are not total return).
MoversResponse.title: MoversResponse

PeersResponse.description:
GET /api/funds/{code}/peers — peer population excludes
comparison-ineligible series.
PeersResponse.title: PeersResponse

ReturnsResponse.description:
GET /api/funds/{code}/returns — NAV-to-NAV horizon changes.

``horizons`` values are NAV change percentages; for IDCW/DIVIDEND they
are NOT total return (see ``methodology``).
ReturnsResponse.title: ReturnsResponse

RiskRewardResponse.description:
GET /api/funds/{code}/risk-reward — population excludes
comparison-ineligible series.

``refreshed`` is absent (v1 shape) when the profile table yields no rows.
RiskRewardResponse.title: RiskRewardResponse
